## Profile {.section-title}

Linguist specialising in the syntax–semantics of Ibero-Romance pronominal systems, with a focus on the (non-)realisation of direct object pronouns. Trained in corpus and experimental methods, and interested in large-scale statistical analysis of linguistic data to model language processing.

## Current position {.section-title}

::: publication-item
### Project Researcher (prae-doc) (2024–present)  
*Institut für Romanistik, Universität Wien (Vienna, Austria)*

- Subproject 07 *Ibero-Romance pronominal systems* 
- SFB [Language between Redundancy and Deficiency](https://sfb-redundancy-deficiency.uni-graz.at/en/)  
- Creating experiments (acceptability, elicitation, eye tracking) for data collection in Spain, Portugal, Brazil, and Argentina
:::
